name: sanad-site
description: Tests for the Sanad static site. The site itself has no build step and no runtime dependencies.

scripts.test: node tools/v8-coverage.mjs clean && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e && npm run coverage
scripts.coverage: c8 report --temp-directory .coverage/v8 --all --include "site/**/*.js" --reporter text --reporter html --reporter json-summary --report-dir coverage --check-coverage --statements 90 --lines 90 --functions 90 --branches 80
